tokens.name: scene-bg
tokens.usage: Near-black background of the 3D view, which fills the whole window. Every glass panel floats over it, and every line or marker drawn in the scene is checked against it.

tokens.name: scene-ground
tokens.usage: The floor tint under the robot: an unlit disc at 85% under the base that dissolves into scene-bg by 1.3 times the reach, with the arm's shadow on it.

tokens.name: scene-grid
tokens.usage: Lines of the polar floor grid: full strength at the centre, fading with radius to 30% at the reach ring.

tokens.name: scene-arm
tokens.usage: Robot arm material when the view mirrors the real robot. Live hardware carries no colour of its own: the arm is plain grey.

tokens.name: scene-arm-sim
tokens.usage: Robot arm material while the simulator drives it. Material albedo: under the scene lights it renders as the same amber as mode-sim. Only the simulator.

tokens.name: scene-arm-edit
tokens.usage: Arm material while a pose is being edited or the arm is inactive; also the inactive TCP marker.

tokens.name: scene-tool
tokens.usage: Body of the attached tool (gripper, vacuum). Teal keeps the tool distinct from the arm in every mode. Also the tool-action bars on the timeline.

tokens.name: scene-tool-moving
tokens.usage: Moving parts of the tool, such as gripper jaws.

tokens.name: scene-tool-edit
tokens.usage: Tool body while the arm is in edit mode.

tokens.name: scene-tool-moving-edit
tokens.usage: Tool moving parts while the arm is in edit mode.

tokens.name: scene-collision
tokens.usage: Arm links in a predicted or actual collision. Same value in both themes: it must look like an alarm on either ground.

tokens.name: scene-shape
tokens.usage: Keep-out shapes that the program defines and the controller has confirmed.

tokens.name: scene-shape-draft
tokens.usage: A program shape still waiting for the controller to confirm it: the same slate as scene-shape, lighter, drawn translucent. Not amber, because amber means simulator.

tokens.name: scene-shape-install
tokens.usage: Installation-layer shapes from the robot config. Read-only in the GUI.

tokens.name: scene-shape-proposed
tokens.usage: An installation shape drafted in the GUI that only takes effect once it is written into the robot config.

tokens.name: scene-hover
tokens.usage: Highlight on the arm link under the pointer.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis: scene gizmo, axis triad, cartesian jog glyphs. A fill and marker colour: as text on glass it is only 2.7:1, so use axis-x-text.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis: scene and jog-glyph fill. Text on glass uses axis-y-text.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis: scene and jog-glyph fill; also the workspace envelope and the active TCP marker. Text on glass uses axis-z-text.

tokens.name: axis-rx
tokens.usage: Rotation about X: jog glyphs and scene arcs. A lighter tint of axis-x.

tokens.name: axis-ry
tokens.usage: Rotation about Y: a lighter tint of axis-y.

tokens.name: axis-rz
tokens.usage: Rotation about Z: a lighter tint of axis-z.

tokens.name: axis-x-text
tokens.usage: X label, value and unit in the pose readout, on the glass: 3.6:1 in dark over the scene and either arm.

tokens.name: axis-y-text
tokens.usage: Y label, value and unit in the pose readout, on the glass: 3.6:1 in dark over the scene and either arm.

tokens.name: axis-z-text
tokens.usage: Z label, value and unit in the pose readout, on the glass: 3.6:1 in dark over the scene and either arm.

tokens.name: axis-rx-text
tokens.usage: Rx label, value and unit in the pose readout, on the glass: 4.8:1 in dark over the scene and either arm.

tokens.name: axis-ry-text
tokens.usage: Ry label, value and unit in the pose readout, on the glass: 5.9:1 in dark over the scene and either arm.

tokens.name: axis-rz-text
tokens.usage: Rz label, value and unit in the pose readout, on the glass: 4.7:1 in dark over the scene and either arm.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Fill of every floating panel, dialog, tab rail and the playback bar: the top-left stop of a 135° gradient to glass-end, with glass-blur behind it. At 86% neutral text keeps at least 4.5:1 over any part of the scene, the arm included. Don't lower the alpha.

tokens.name: glass-end
tokens.usage: Bottom-right stop of the glass gradient.

tokens.name: glass-border
tokens.usage: 1px edge on glass panels and dialogs. In light theme this edge is what separates a panel from the pale scene. Also the outline of the code editor and the folder tab that rises out of it.

tokens.name: well
tokens.usage: Recessed areas inside a panel: the log, text fields, expansion headers, the event log, the upload list. Nested wells use radius-sm.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims the scene behind modal dialogs and the takeover overlay.

tokens.name: state-hover
tokens.usage: Layered over a control, tab or row while the pointer is on it.

tokens.name: state-selected
tokens.usage: Active editor tab, selected list or tree row, pressed state. For a toggled control use action instead.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Default text and icons on glass, well and control. At least 6.4:1 on glass over any backdrop in both themes.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on glass and well: setting descriptions, units, timestamps, hints, placeholder text, chart axis labels. At least 4.7:1 over any backdrop.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Labels of disabled controls only. Exempt from contrast minimums, so never use it for information.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on estop and the fill-* Quasar fills (4.5:1 and above; 3.7:1 on estop, where it is an icon).

tokens.name: on-bright
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the bright fills: action, action-hover, run, mode-sim, warning-fill and the AI accents (4.5:1 and above).

tokens.name: action
tokens.usage: The one filled primary button in a group, the selected segment of a toggle, a switch that is on, the live output on the I/O chips. A bright fill: glyphs and text on it use on-bright. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: action-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for anything painted with action. Also Quasar's secondary.

tokens.name: action-text
tokens.usage: Links, ghost-button text in the action colour, and the selected-tab indicator, on glass. At least 5.2:1 over any backdrop. Also Quasar's accent.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard-focus outline, offset 2px. At least 3.2:1 in dark and 4.1:1 in light on glass over any backdrop.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Resting fill of neutral controls: round icon buttons, unselected toggle segments, the record button, joint-bar tracks. Label it with text.

tokens.name: progress
tokens.usage: The filled part of a level indicator against a control track: joint-bar travel and the played part of the playback bar. Clears 3:1 against control (3.6 dark, 4.0 light) and against glass over any backdrop. The joint value crosses it in text with a scrim halo.

tokens.name: level-speed-lo
tokens.usage: First dot of the speed ramp. The ten speed dots run from level-speed-lo to level-speed-hi, mixed in OKLCH per dot; unselected dots sit on the same ramp at 40% opacity. A level indicator: the hue is data, not decoration.

tokens.name: level-speed-hi
tokens.usage: Last dot of the speed ramp.

tokens.name: level-accel-lo
tokens.usage: First dot of the acceleration ramp, lime to teal, mixed in OKLCH per dot like the speed ramp.

tokens.name: level-accel-hi
tokens.usage: Last dot of the acceleration ramp.

tokens.name: mode-sim
tokens.usage: The simulator, and nothing else: the Robot/Simulator toggle while simulating, and the SIM chip. Always a fill with on-bright on it, never text. Warnings, speed, drafts and tips don't use amber. The fill itself is not a contrast carrier: against glass it falls to 2.2:1 over a white or black object. Its icon (5.6:1), its label and its fixed position identify it.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Connected, succeeded, reached, engaged. Text and icons on glass, at least 5.3:1 over any backdrop. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: positive-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a positive badge (text: positive) and of added lines in an editor diff.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution text and icons on glass: log warnings, timing problems, 'Duration too short'. At least 4.8:1 over any backdrop. Always behind a warning icon, because in light theme yellow-800 sits close to mode-sim in hue.

tokens.name: warning-fill
tokens.usage: Caution fills, with on-bright on top: freedrive active (brakes released), the Allow button on hardware-motion consent, warning banners.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of a warning badge or banner.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Failed, disconnected, unreachable. Text and icons on glass, log errors, field validation messages. At least 4.8:1 over any backdrop. Always paired with an icon or a word.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Background of an error badge, removed lines in an editor diff, and a critical log line (with text on it).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information: trace log lines, tips, the hint icon in the readout, the idle tool-state dot. Shares action-text's value, so never put it on something clickable.

tokens.name: run
tokens.usage: Fill of the Play and Run buttons (the cycle-start convention). Icon in on-bright.

tokens.name: estop
tokens.usage: Fill of the E-Stop button, and nothing else. No other control is a filled red circle; the record button is a control with a record dot. Icon in on-action (3.7:1 dark, 4.6:1 light; an icon needs 3:1). The disc is not a contrast carrier: against glass it falls to 1.8:1 in dark over a white object and 3.3:1 in light. Its icon, its size, its shape (the only filled circle) and its fixed position identify it.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: The record dot on the record button and the recording pulse, in the record red. Never a fill. It is 2:1 on control: the round control fill carries the affordance, the dot carries the meaning.

tokens.name: fill-positive
tokens.usage: What Quasar's `positive` resolves to. Quasar paints notifications, badges and banners with it and puts white text on top (5.1:1). Not for hand-placed colour: use positive or positive-soft.

tokens.name: fill-warning
tokens.usage: What Quasar's `warning` resolves to, with white text on it (4.7:1). Not for hand-placed colour: use warning, warning-fill or warning-soft.

tokens.name: fill-error
tokens.usage: What Quasar's `negative` resolves to, with white text on it (6.2:1). Not a control: the E-Stop stays the only filled red control. Field validation text is restyled to error.

tokens.name: ai-inspect
tokens.usage: Inspect-mode accent: the capsule border, perimeter glow and Take-control fill. Only inside the AI capsule and glow.

tokens.name: ai-inspect-text
tokens.usage: Inspect-mode chip label in the capsule. At least 4.6:1 over any backdrop.

tokens.name: ai-auto-edits
tokens.usage: Auto-edits-mode accent. Capsule and glow only.

tokens.name: ai-auto-edits-text
tokens.usage: Auto-edits-mode chip label. At least 5.2:1 over any backdrop.

tokens.name: ai-autopilot
tokens.usage: Autopilot-mode accent. Capsule and glow only.

tokens.name: ai-autopilot-text
tokens.usage: Autopilot-mode chip label. At least 5:1 over any backdrop.

tokens.name: measure-position
tokens.usage: The position series in the gripper chart: line, marker, target mark-line and the position dot in the tool readout. A graphic, 3.7:1 on glass over any backdrop; axis labels stay text-muted and the legend names the series.

tokens.name: measure-current
tokens.usage: The motor-current series in the gripper chart: line, marker, limit mark-line and the current dot. Magenta because amber means simulator. 3.9:1 dark, 4.4:1 light on glass over any backdrop.

tokens.name: path-cartesian
tokens.usage: Linear (cartesian) moves and jog segments in the path preview. 7.2:1 on the dark scene, 4.1:1 on the light one.

tokens.name: path-joints
tokens.usage: Joint-space moves in the path preview. 3.5:1 dark, 3.9:1 light against scene-bg.

tokens.name: path-smooth
tokens.usage: Smooth moves (arc, spline) in the path preview. 4.6:1 dark, 4.2:1 light.

tokens.name: path-invalid
tokens.usage: Segments that fail IK or can't be reached. 4.9:1 dark, 3.6:1 light. Wins over path-timing-warning when both apply.

tokens.name: path-timing-warning
tokens.usage: Segments whose estimated duration exceeds the requested one. Yellow warning, not amber. 11.6:1 dark, 3.7:1 light. Not wired yet: the preview computes timing_feasible but the renderer colours by move type and validity only; the migration maps it.

tokens.name: path-checkpoint
tokens.usage: Checkpoint markers on the timeline scrubber.

tokens.name: path-tool-action
tokens.usage: Tool-action bars on the timeline scrubber. Painted in the tool's own teal.

tokens.name: physics-on-track
tokens.usage: Start of the achieved-path gradient: the simulated arm is on its commanded path. Also the legend swatch. 10.1:1 dark, 3.7:1 light against scene-bg.

tokens.name: physics-diverged
tokens.usage: End of the achieved-path gradient, at full tracking error. Vertex colours interpolate from physics-on-track to this. 5.5:1 dark, 3.6:1 light.

tokens.name: physics-contact
tokens.usage: Contact-force arrows and their legend swatch. 6.1:1 dark, 3.6:1 light.

tokens.name: physics-com
tokens.usage: Centre-of-mass sphere, its drop line and legend swatch. Neutral, so it reads as a marker and not as a status. 14.5:1 dark, 11.5:1 light.

tokens.name: editor-exec-line
tokens.usage: Background of the line the running program is executing (the debugger convention). Nothing else in the editor is yellow.

families.mono: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", "Courier New", monospace

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Dialog headlines and the E-Stop banner. At most one per dialog.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel titles (Program, I/O, Log), dialog titles, the backend name in the readout.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Setting names, tab labels, button text, joint names. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Hold a jog key for continuous movement.
styles.usage: Running text in dialogs and help.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Setting descriptions, tooltips, units, hints, action-log lines, chart axis labels. Usually text-muted.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: I/O chips, keyboard keys, step-size suffixes. The smallest size in the app.

styles.name: readout-lg
styles.usage: Live X/Y/Z position. Set with tabular numerals so digits don't shift while jogging.

styles.name: readout
styles.usage: Rx/Ry/Rz, speed, joint values. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: The program editor and the log panel.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label, between chips, inside button groups.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls in a row or column.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Panel inset from the window edge, panel padding, gap between floating panels.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Separation between sections in a dialog; dialog padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Controls: buttons, text fields, toggle segments, editor tabs (top corners), wells and anything nested inside a panel, keyboard keys.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Glass panels, dialogs, tab rails, the robot status chip.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Joint bars and their value pill, the playback bar, the AI capsule, round icon buttons, the E-Stop.

shadow.note: The glass reflex: three inset strokes for the lit edge plus one soft drop. Stronger in light theme, where the panel sits on a pale scene.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every glass surface: panels, dialogs, tab rails, the playback bar, the AI capsule. The only shadow in the system.

size.note: Fixed dimensions the layout and the jog math depend on.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of a button or icon button.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Inline controls inside an editor tab (rename field, save and close buttons).

tokens.name: size-joint-bar
tokens.usage: Joint-bar height; its end caps are the same size square.

tokens.name: size-jog-slot
tokens.usage: Hit box of one cartesian jog glyph.

tokens.name: size-rail
tokens.usage: Width of the vertical side-tab rail. Left panels start at size-rail plus space-1 plus the rail's inset.

effect.note: Backdrop filter for glass, as one blur and one saturation.

tokens.name: glass-blur
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur behind every glass surface, the playback bar included.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Backdrop saturation behind glass. Applied after glass-blur.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: A disabled control (Quasar's own value). Its label switches to text-disabled.

tokens.name: opacity-locked
tokens.usage: Controls locked out while the AI drives or the session belongs to another tab: greyscale plus this opacity, no pointer events.

zIndex.note: App layers from the scene up. Panels keep their own stacking context inside the panels layer, so resize handles and in-panel overlays use small local values.

tokens.name: z-scene
tokens.usage: The 3D canvas.

tokens.name: z-loading
tokens.usage: The connecting and loading screen.

tokens.name: z-hud
tokens.usage: Non-interactive overlays drawn over the scene.

tokens.name: z-panels
tokens.usage: Floating panels, the physics legend, the playback bar.

tokens.name: z-rail
tokens.usage: The top side-tab rail.

tokens.name: z-rail-bottom
tokens.usage: The bottom side-tab rail (Log, Help).

tokens.name: z-glow
tokens.usage: The AI perimeter glow.

tokens.name: z-capsule
tokens.usage: The AI capsule and the takeover overlay. Stays above Quasar dialogs (6000).

duration.note: Every animation stops under prefers-reduced-motion except the press feedback.

tokens.name: duration-instant
tokens.usage: Press feedback on jog controls.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, colour and resize-handle changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Panels sliding in and out, overlays moving on resize, the AI capsule border.

tokens.name: duration-flash
tokens.usage: The one-off highlight when new content arrives: an editor line or tab.

tokens.name: duration-ambient
tokens.usage: Looping signals: the AI glow and Take-control pulse, the recording pulse.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Things arriving or settling: panel slides, flashes.

tokens.name: ease-loop
tokens.usage: Looping signals and breathing.

tokens.name: ease-pop
tokens.usage: The Take-control button popping into the capsule. Nothing else overshoots.
